svg.metadata: {"id": "s050", "name": "太空站", "cat": "科学", "tags": ["科学", "航天", "天宫课堂", "宇宙"], "desc": "近地轨道上的空间站：T 字形舱段、巨大的太阳能帆板、对接的飞船与机械臂，下方是蓝色地球与大气光边，远处有月亮和闪烁的星星。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [560, 1360]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "space", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "stars", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.15, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}, {"name": "moon", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "earth", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "earth_clouds", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.6, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "atmosphere", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.5, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "solar_wings", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "modules", "enter": "zoom", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "spacecraft", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "robot_arm", "enter": "grow", "delay": 1.0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "beacons", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}, {"name": "satellite", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sp1": "#141A3C", "sp2": "#28306E", "sp3": "#4C3F88", "star": "#FFFFFF", "star2": "#FFE9B0", "earth1": "#5BB3E6", "earth2": "#2F7FC2", "earth3": "#1F5E9C", "land": "#7CC48E", "land2": "#B3DC8C", "land3": "#E9D49A", "cloudE": "#FFFFFF", "atm": "#9FE6FF", "mod": "#F1F4F8", "mod2": "#CED7E2", "mod3": "#A6B3C3", "gold": "#EDBB5C", "gold2": "#C9973E", "panel": "#28468A", "panel2": "#3E68B8", "grid": "#93B2EA", "truss": "#8B96A8", "red": "#EE5A4A", "sun": "#FFF3C4", "moon": "#ECE7F4", "moon2": "#CFC6E0"}}
